Summed driver_ready_events = 59,843 (3.4 %) and driver_bounded_events = 92,904 (5.3 %) of heat events (packet quotes 3.3 % / 4.8 % from the 1,000 sample); gas-mark-only 247; TASTESET has 0 events (ingredient lists only). components.name: Layer 2 SCENARIO driver trajectories (GENTLE/TYPICAL/INTENSE) for heat events
components.ssot_anchor: D-077; §141; SSOT L6036-6048 (drivers theta(x,t))
status_evidence: packet s4: 810,951 heat events (46 %) get trajectories
components.what_exists: Per heat event three coherent brackets (low/mid/high bath T, duration from corpus quantiles, h, half-thickness, T0) give core temperature trajectory, time above thresholds, equivalent-minute dose (T_ref 100 C, z 33 C) and an immersion surface cook value; labels SCENARIO, MODEL_DERIVED, NON_CITABLE, ASSUMED_DEFAULT; transition 'physically_possible' for computed events, 'unsupported' otherwise; no nutrient numbers. Counts-only, status AI_ENGINEERING_DRY_RUN_COUNTS_ONLY.
components.gap_vs_ssot: 54 % of heat events are SCENARIO_UNKNOWN or UNSUPPORTED_MEDIUM (e.g. no duration, no medium); one k/alpha class for all foods; half-thickness only by cut class; bath and h are medium defaults; Layer 2 is a dry run status, not accepted; circularity risk Q1 (models learning the defaults table).
